description: GIVEN one root config whose rootTranslationsPath is in project a of a multi-project workspace WHEN the keys of project b are extracted with --replace and --remove-extra-keys THEN they are written to the default folder of b and the translations of a are left alone
stderrMatches: is outside project b \(projects/b\)\. Writing to <cwd>/projects/b/src/assets/i18n instead\.
